In the instant petition, petitioners have prayed for the following relief:-
That this writ application is being filed for issuance of writ, order or direction to pay i) Compensation of lands (described in para-3) acquired by the Respondents according to Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (New Act 2013);
